description: Message is one message the visitor has sent, as the page lists it.

id.description: ID is the message's number in the order it arrived.

email.description: Email is the address they gave.

attachment.description: Attachment is the uploaded file's name, or empty when there was none.

attachmentBytes.description: AttachmentBytes is how many bytes of it reached Go.

attachmentDigest.description: AttachmentDigest is the first twelve hex digits of the SHA-256 of those bytes. It is on the page because a byte count alone cannot tell an upload that arrived from one that arrived scrambled — the digest changes if a single byte moved, which is exactly the failure kit's smallest-file-first body ordering invites.
